comments.author: Speenks
comments.body_html:
Oh yes. At most, it might change some of the resource values of existing medical items, so you may see oddities such as 1/2 use bandages, or 3/2 use caloks.

All of the custom items are brand new IDs, so they won’t harm anything on an existing profile. If you obtain some of these items and then remove the mod without deleting the custom items, that’s where you could encounter issues.

comments.author: Speenks
comments.body_html: Oh, sorry, I should probably add that this is more or less an alternative to any other medical system and therefore incompatible 😅 I’m happy that you were able to arrive at a solution, and if it works best for you, you should keep it that way. However, the intended configuration is to just choose one or the other. Even though I believe the original mod was designed for both, I do not personally use Realism’s medical changes, as much as I want the hazard zones- they are unfortunately incompatible with Fika.
